legacy.label: unmodified legacy cl.bcs.utils.SQL + NamedParameterStatement + IdsEntidadYPerfiles compiled from legacy/ (read-only) and the legacy .sql files, run on HANA QA through a read-only JDBC connection (SELECT only), JDK 25

new.label: modernized BcsSURA LegacyHanaSuraPort (src/main) on the same HANA QA, via SuraHanaEquivalenciaTest (tag hana)

note: Read queries only (ids, perfiles, filtrados). Rows are sorted on both sides (SQL has no ORDER BY); same column order; nulls would print as <null> on the legacy side (none occurred). Deviation on the legacy side: the temp table of the filtered query is an inline derived table (SELECT CAST(..) FROM DUMMY UNION ALL ..), as in the new code, because a temp table is DDL. Not covered: INSERT/UPDATE statements (SELECT-only rule), the message dictionary lookup, flow logic above the port. QA data can change between runs.
